title: 第十五章 开启大阵第十六章 胆小鼠辈
lines: 九重天上，南天门外束升大阵里面正有一群神仙，一眼望去，为首的是一个仙风道骨的老头，此人正是太白金星。
“金星大人，要不您再考虑考虑”此时一个离太白金星较近的一个神仙开口了。
“是啊，是啊，大人请你再三考虑啊”
其他人见有人劝阻太白金星于是便都开口劝道。
只是那太白金星仍旧继续做着开启束升大阵的准备工作。
“噗通!噗通!噗通!”
见劝说无果，在束升大阵内的神仙除了太白金星都纷纷下跪，更有些人竟抱着太白金星的腿开始哭了起来，那哭的甚是凄惨，鼻涕一把泪一把，不知情的人还以为他家里出什么事了呢。
面对这阵仗，就连太白金星也是为之一愣不知如何是好。
远远一望，此时的场景非常壮观。
“让他用!”
忽然在束升大阵外传来了一道声音，这声音是如此的威严，如此的洪亮。
虽然只是简简单单几个字，但这声音却威慑力十足，让人听了就感到生畏。
先前还苦苦哀求太白金星不要开启大阵的几个神仙听到此声，先是为之一颤竟真的停止劝阻太白金星了。
他们几个纷纷站了起来，低头不语，从这就可以看出这个男人说话的分量是如此之重!
只见南天门前有一男子正靠坐在一个巨大椅子之上，这椅子通体金黄有一种非常神圣的气息。
没错，这个男子就是刚才发出声音的那个人。
如果说一个东西所散发出的气势与他的主人所散发的气质相吻合，我们都把这称之为非常匹配。
但这个气势非常神圣无比的椅子和那个男人相比，就仿佛是一个低头弯腰的臣子死心塌地的让他的君王坐在他的身上一般，是那样的臣服，是那般的忠心。
男子的衣着样貌更是不简单。
首先最引人注意的是他的面容，此人虽然已到不惑之年，但是他面容可不像寻常中年那般油腻。
那成熟又霸道的气质，那英气十足的脸颊，那阅历无数又有点忧郁的深邃眼神，他是当下无数少女所喜欢所追求的那种大叔类型!
只见他壮硕的英姿穿着一席淡黄色长袍，头戴一顶无比神气的发冠，令人惊讶的是这淡黄色长袍上面还团着一条金鳞巨龙，这巨龙活灵活现霸气非常，好像时刻就要冲出来，而他的发冠好似马上要飞的凤凰一样，是那样的华丽，是那样的引人瞩目。
此发冠就是传说中的三山飞凤冠!而此袍竟是传说中的鹅黄龙袍!
看到这里大家应该就猜出此人是谁了。
没错!这个男人正是清源妙道真君、灌口小圣二郎神杨戬!
此时他低着头仔细的把玩着一个小木牌。
只不过，这小木牌就是由最普通最平常的木头所作，做工粗糙，光秃秃的上面只刻了一个“孙”字，很不起眼，甚至有些破旧，但从他的动作就可以看出他对这木牌很是惜爱。
“你们是木头吗？还愣着干嘛，还不赶紧协助开启束升大阵!”
二郎神将木牌收入怀中，扭过头，用那犀利的眼神盯着那群神仙。
“是……是是!遵命大人!”
那群神仙看到二郎神这个样子，可真把他们吓坏了，一个个脸色煞白，颤颤巍巍的开始了开启束升大阵的准备工作。
太白金星见到这一幕也是为之一愣，笑了笑说道：“老夫多谢小圣大人了，不愧是小圣可真是……”
“够了!”
还没等太白金星说完话，却被二郎神硬生生打断了。
“老头!少给我拍马屁，我堂堂灌口真君，却被他差遣到这当护法，要不是他答应我给我想要的东西，谁会来这!还不速速开启大阵，不要浪费我的时间!”
“是!小圣”
太白金星当然知道二郎神所说的他是谁了，那个他就是太白金星所恭敬所敬仰的主子玉帝大人。
但面对二郎神不尊重玉帝，太白金星也不敢说什么，毕竟谁都知道二郎神和玉帝之间那微妙的关系，玉帝的命令谁敢不服从，可这二郎神却偏偏只听调不听宣，甚至来这里给大阵做护法都需要报酬。
准确来说二郎神杨戬自从他劈山救母的时候起，二郎神就已经把玉帝称为他了。
见太白金星和那群神仙已经快要准备完毕，二郎神便负手而立背对着他们，目视远处行走在天宫道上刚刚飞升成仙的人们，谁也不知道此时二郎神正在想着什么。
content_en:
In the Nine Heavens, there was a group of immortals in the Shusheng Formation outside the Nantian Gate. At a glance, the leader was an old man with an immortal spirit. This person was none other than Taibai Jinxing.
"Lord Venus, why don't you think about it again?" At this time, a god who was closer to Taibai Venus spoke.
"Yes, yes, sir, please think again."
When the others saw someone trying to dissuade Taibai Jinxing, they all started to persuade him.
It's just that Taibai Jinxing is still making preparations to open the Shusheng Formation.
"Plop! Plop! Plop!"
Seeing that the persuasion was fruitless, all the gods in the Shusheng Formation except Taibaijinxing knelt down one after another. Some even hugged Taibaijinxing's legs and began to cry. The crying was very miserable, with runny noses and tears. People who didn't know it thought something had happened to his family.
Facing this battle, even Taibai Jinxing was stunned and didn't know what to do.
Looking from a distance, the scene at this time is very spectacular.
"Let him use it!"
Suddenly, a voice came from outside the Shusheng Formation. The voice was so majestic and loud.
Although it was just a few words, the voice was so intimidating that it made people feel intimidated.
Several gods who had previously begged Taibai Jinxing not to activate the formation heard this, and were trembling at first and actually stopped trying to dissuade Taibai Jinxing.
Several of them stood up one after another and bowed their heads in silence. From this, it can be seen that the weight of this man's words is so important!
I saw a man sitting on a huge chair in front of the Nantian Gate. The chair was golden in color and had a very sacred aura.
Yes, this man is the one who made the sound just now.
If the aura exuded by an object matches the aura exuded by its owner, we all call it a perfect match.
But compared with that man, this chair with a very sacred aura was like a bowed-down courtier who was determined to let his king sit on him. It was so surrendering and loyal.
The man's clothing and appearance are even more complicated.
First of all, the most eye-catching thing is his face. Although this man is in his forties, his face is not as greasy as that of ordinary middle-aged people.
With his mature and domineering temperament, his heroic cheeks, and his deep eyes with a lot of experience and a bit of melancholy, he is the type of uncle that countless girls like and pursue nowadays!
I saw his majestic and heroic figure wearing a light yellow robe and a very impressive hair crown. What is surprising is that this light yellow robe is also covered with a giant dragon with golden scales. This giant dragon is vivid and domineering, as if it is about to rush out at any moment, and his hair crown is like a phoenix about to fly. It is so gorgeous and eye-catching.
This hair crown is the legendary Three Mountains Flying Phoenix Crown! And this robe is actually the legendary goose-yellow dragon robe!
Everyone should have guessed who this person is after seeing this.
That’s right! This man is none other than Qingyuan Miao Dao Zhenjun, Guankou Little Sage Erlang God Yang Jian!
At this time, he lowered his head and carefully played with a small wooden sign.
However, this small wooden sign was made of the most ordinary wood, with rough workmanship, and only the word "Sun" was engraved on the bare surface. It was very inconspicuous and even a little shabby, but it could be seen from his actions that he cherished this wooden sign.
"Are you just stupid? Why are you still standing there? Why don't you hurry up and help open the Shu Sheng Formation!"
Erlang Shen put the wooden sign in his arms, turned his head, and stared at the group of gods with his sharp eyes.
"Yes...yes! Yes, sir!"
The group of gods were really frightened when they saw Erlang Shen like this. Each of them turned pale and tremblingly started the preparations for opening the Shu Sheng Formation.
Taibai Jinxing was also stunned when he saw this scene. He smiled and said, "Thank you so much, Mr. Little Sage. You are worthy of being a Little Sage..."
"Enough!"
Before Taibai Jinxing could finish speaking, he was abruptly interrupted by Erlang Shen.
"Old man! Stop flattering me. I pretend to be the True Lord, but he sent me here as a protector. If he hadn't promised to give me what I want, who would have come here! Don't waste my time by opening the formation quickly!"
"Yes! Little Saint"
Of course Taibai Jinxing knew who Erlang Shen was talking about. That person was the Master Jade Emperor whom Taibai Jinxing respected and respected.
But in the face of Erlang Shen's disrespect for the Jade Emperor, Taibai Jinxing did not dare to say anything. After all, everyone knew the subtle relationship between Erlang Shen and the Jade Emperor. Who dared to disobey the Jade Emperor's orders, but this Erlang Shen only listened to the instructions but not the announcement. Even coming here to protect the formation required payment.
To be precise, Erlang God Yang Jian has called him the Jade Emperor since he cut down the mountain to save his mother.
Seeing that Taibai Jinxing and the group of gods were almost ready, Erlang Shen stood with his hands behind his back and turned his back to them, looking at the people walking on the Tiangong Road in the distance who had just ascended to immortality. No one knew what Erlang Shen was thinking at this time.
